field_principles.status: Terminal state separates complete measurement from instrument failure.
field_principles.test_commands: Verification commands are recorded with the artifact.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Exit codes prevent unchecked test claims.
field_principles.treatment_fire_counts: A zero-fire treatment is an instrument failure, not a null.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because replay evaluation is not hidden-game oracle access.
